description: Retrieve the full text of one HelloBooks public knowledge document by the `id` returned from `search` (e.g. "plan:pro", "deadline:IN:gstr-3b", "competitor:xero"). Returns `{ id, title, text, url, metadata }` where `url` is the public hellobooks.ai page to cite. Call `search` first — ids are not guessable.

id.description: A document id returned by `search`, e.g. "plan:pro" or "deadline:IN:gstr-3b".

name: fetch
title: Fetch a HelloBooks public document
